summary: Fixed the only open finding, QA-1. Hiding the git drawer used to unmount GitDrawer and lose the commit-message draft held in ChangesView. App.tsx now remembers the last tab (gitTabKept) and keeps the drawer mounted inside a wrapper hidden while gitTab is null, so closing the drawer (Close control, palette 'Close git drawer', Reset layout or opening the console) leaves the typed message intact and reopening shows it again. openApp resets gitTabKept so each app visit still starts calm with no drawer, and the show commands (GitBar Changes/History, the palette Git commands, the drawer's own tabs) go through the new openGitTab helper. Added an R8 test that types a commit message, closes the drawer, and reopens it to assert the message is still there. npm run lint, the related Vitest files (App.layout, App.features, App.shortcuts, App.test, git) and npm run build all pass.
